Class Competition

  • java.lang.Object
    • Competition

  • public class Competition
extends java.lang.Object
    This Competition class is used to store, arrange and showcase data from the Personality class for a competition of votes. The list can contain as many people as possible, but only if there aren't any duplicated names stored. The amount of votes per person can be increased, but not decreased. Shorter lists can be created, such as putting a minimum amount of votes needed to be in said list or the objects with the most votes (Amount determined by user). The information about the list can be printed out to the user at any time. Error messages will appear when inavlid inputs are created by the user.

      • getMost

        public java.util.ArrayList<Personality> getMost(int index)
        Parameters:
        "index" - integer variable to store (user input) value that will be used to choose the top select few of the Personality object list. Create new clone list of the "personList" ArrayList under the name of "newList". Sort the new list with a comparitor by the amount of votes (getVotes()) in reverse order. If index is equal to zero, clear the list. return Returns The empty list. Else if the index is greater than or equal to the number of personalities, all personalities in the list are returned. return Returns the full list. While loop created when index is smaller than the size of the new list (newList) and index is not 0. If the newlist index and amount of votes is not equal to one vote below index, remove index. Else add index by 1.
        Returns:
        The newly created list containing the top selected objects depending on the index.

      • shortlist

        public void shortlist(int minimumVotes)
        Parameters:
        "minimumVotes" - integer to store a numerical (user input) value to carry out the rest of the method. New Iterator list from the "Personality" class named "list", which contains the "personList" (ArrayList) with the original objects. While loop where the it uses a ".hadNext" serving as a flag if there are objects to iterate over on the "list" Iterator. If the next vote (from "getVotes()") within the Personality list is below the minimumVotes, remove the list.

      • voteFor

        public void voteFor(java.lang.String name)
        Parameters:
        "name" - String to store the name user inputs through the method. New Iterator list from the "Personality" class named "voteList", which contains the "personList" (ArrayList) with the original objects. While loop where the it returns true if the method returns a boolean data type (true), serving as a flag if there are objects to iterate over. Assign the Personality class as "votes", which is then assigned to the "voteList". If the name of voteList equals the name of the Personality class objects, increase the votes on Personality class objects by 1.
